_about: Single source for sequences A to F, the Call 2 sequences (R, RN, RC, RS), the Nurture and Won follow-ups, and the rep tasks. deliverables/23-crm/build.py turns this file into 18-sequences-A-to-F.md (for review) and into the Sequences section of the CRM Apps Script (for sending). Edit here, then run build.py. Source: references/sales-pipeline/Sales_Pipeline_and_Automation_Playbook.txt, with WhatsApp in place of SMS.

rules.whatsapp_hours: WhatsApp only between 08:00 and 20:00 in the lead's timezone (Cal.com attendee timezone, else the default_timezone setting). A step due outside the window waits for the next 08:00; a pre-call reminder that would land after the call starts is skipped.
rules.stop: Every sequence with stops_on_reply stops the moment the lead replies, books, or the deal changes stage. A and B are booking logistics: they stop on cancel, stage change past the call, or opt-out, not on a YES reply.
rules.opt_out: STOP in any channel tags the contact Do Not Contact and cancels every pending step.
rules.optional_lines: A line that starts with ? is dropped when one of its merge fields is empty; otherwise the ? is removed.

merge_fields.closer: The assigned closer's first name (Conor or Scott), from the Cal.com organizer email matched against the Closers table on the Lists tab
merge_fields.call_day: Call date in the lead's timezone, for example Thursday 12 November
merge_fields.call_time: Call time in the lead's timezone, for example 3:00 PM
merge_fields.lead_timezone: The lead's timezone name from Cal.com
merge_fields.join_link: Meeting link from the Cal.com booking (Google Meet)
merge_fields.booking_link: booking.round_robin_url in funnel-config.json (Lists tab setting booking_url)
merge_fields.goal: The lead's answer to the bottleneck question
merge_fields.call_notes: Pipeline.notes, written by the closer after the call
merge_fields.onboarding_link: Onboarding call booking link (Lists tab setting onboarding_link)
merge_fields.call2_link: The deal closer's own Proposal Review booking link (booking.call2.<closer>_url in funnel-config.json; Lists tab Closers table, closer_call2_url). Missing: the message is blocked, never sent without it
merge_fields.call2_day: Call 2 date in the lead's timezone, from the proposal-review booking (Pipeline.call2_date)
merge_fields.call2_time: Call 2 time in the lead's timezone
merge_fields.call2_join_link: Meeting link from the Call 2 booking (Pipeline.call2_join_link)

steps.subject: How a UK Coaching Group Booked 80 Sales Calls From Webinars
steps.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

While you weigh the proposal, here's what the same build did for a client in a similar position.

Growth Idea is a UK business-coaching group for owner-led businesses. We built their webinar funnel with them: calendar-invite outreach, registration pages tested against each other, reminders, the live session, follow-up and a weekly analytics sheet.

Over 11 webinars, May 2025 to Feb 2026:
- 6,517 people registered
- 1,384 came live
- 80 sales calls booked
- 4 clients won

The full breakdown is here: {{due_diligence_url}}

We can go through how that maps to your proposal on your Proposal Review. Book it here: {{call2_link}}

{{closer}}
Tantra
